scope: Finite sequential simulated interviews using the same model/effort, but natural answer histories and some source-derived typed recall prompts differ. This is an explicit grading-policy comparison, not a frozen-context causal latency or population accuracy comparison. Published old/new reviews and all missing, incorrect, incomplete and stale outcomes remain intact; memory success never repairs original speech recognition.
